description: This Java class 'HtmlWidget' in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model' package handles the rendering and management of HTML widgets within the OFBiz framework. It includes support for templates, decorators, sub-widgets, and HTML content manipulation, leveraging FreeMarker for template processing and Jsoup for HTML parsing and validation.

classes.name: ExtendedWrapper
classes.description: A custom BeansWrapper for FreeMarker templates that wraps String and Collection objects for proper HTML encoding.

classes.name: StringHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: A wrapper for String objects to ensure HTML encoding in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: CollectionHtmlWrapperForFtl
classes.description: A wrapper for Collection objects to ensure HTML encoding in FreeMarker templates.

classes.name: HtmlTemplate
classes.description: Represents an inline or external HTML template with support for rendering via FreeMarker, including multi-block handling.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecorator
classes.description: Handles decorated sections within templates, allowing content insertion at designated points.

classes.name: HtmlTemplateDecoratorSection
classes.description: Represents a section within a decorator, containing sub-widgets.

methods.name: renderHtmlTemplate
methods.description: Renders an HTML template at a given location, supporting .ftl FreeMarker templates, with boundary comments and error handling.

methods.name: writeError
methods.description: Writes an error message to the provided Appendable writer.
